text:
- **Owner questions:** Ask-tool questions can now be answered on the site or in chat, and the first answer wins. Questions now close from hook events, and transcript and rollout reads are removed.
- **Agent review checks:** The AGENTS.md check now gives the same verdict on every rerun. Its CI jobs run faster, and the verdicts did not change.
- **Agent sessions:** pm no longer installs a git hook, and session start sets up each new worktree. Owner replies reach a session by push alone, and Claude Code auto memory is off in this repo.
- **Test reliability:** `make test-go` passes on every run. The service end-to-end test now takes a kernel-picked free port.
